SRC-359:R001.text: AD-001 Retry-Eligibility: Do not permit auto-replay upon timeout or crash without durable reconciliation

SRC-359:R002.text: AD-002 Diagnostic-Correlation: Linked correlation across operator input, launcher process, and final ACK

SRC-359:R003.text: AD-003 Delivery-Evidence: Ticket completion contract requires real canonical commit and delivery evidence

SRC-359:R004.text: AD-004 Process-Tree-Lifecycle: Verified Windows PID and descendant tree cleanup without orphan processes

SRC-359:R005.text: AD-005 Immutable-Evidence-Manifest: Phase transitions require immutable evidence bindings and REVERIFY checks

SRC-359:R006.text: AD-006 Premature-Handback-Prevention: Prohibit completion or final success before all phases and validation are DONE

SRC-359:R007.text: AD-007 Sandbox-Isolation: Diagnostic probes must not invoke continue or mutate foreign live projects

SRC-359:R008.text: AD-008 Artifact-Provenance: Distinguish dirty working tree files from staged and installed artifacts
